outcome: Disease course in pregnant women with COVID-19
Risk of maternal-fetal transmission of COVID-19
Frequency of symptoms (dyspnea, cough, fever, headache, muscle aches, chills, diarrhea)
finding: The study indicated that pregnant women with COVID-19 experienced a more severe disease course, including increased ICU admissions and mechanical ventilation, compared to non-pregnant women with COVID-19.
mod_finding: Premature delivery and cesarean section were more common in pregnant women diagnosed with COVID-19.
